SELECT
    RAWTOHEX(p.PACKAGE_ID) AS PACKAGE_ID,
    CASE
        WHEN p.DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL
        THEN p.DESCRIPTION || ' - (' || p.PACKAGE_CODE || ')'
        ELSE p.PACKAGE_CODE
    END
    || ' | MC On Us: ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(p.MC_ON_US), 'N/A')
    || ' | MC Off Us: ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(p.MC_OFF_US), 'N/A')
    || ' | Visa On Us: ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(p.VISA_ON_US), 'N/A')
    || ' | Visa Off Us: ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(p.VISA_OFF_US), 'N/A')
    || ' | Meeza On Us: ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(p.MEEZA_ON_US), 'N/A')
    || ' | Meeza Off Us: ' || NVL(TO_CHAR(p.MEEZA_OFF_US), 'N/A')
    AS DESCRIPTION
FROM TALY_BO_REP.MMS_PACKAGE p
ORDER BY p.PACKAGE_CODE
